label: associative-stress-01
order: cycle through the 8 cues in fixed order; each presentation is the forward-paired reinforcement trial of the circuit timing

post_history.reversal: backward-erasure-plus-swap from the post-history paired checkpoint

metrics: fraction of eligible edges at the lower/upper bound after every probe cycle, per compartment
recent memory: summed MBON05+MBON01 response to the cue reinforced last, relative to its unit-gain probe
old memory: same for the cue reinforced longest ago
post-history acquisition and reversal verdicts with the conditioning-02 criteria

selection_criteria.bound_occupancy: fraction of eligible edges at the lower bound after 24 cycles <= 0.10 in both compartments
selection_criteria.recent_memory: summed response depression of the most recently reinforced cue >= 3 x the frozen-probe null in every seed
selection_criteria.post_history_acquisition: conditioning-02 acquisition criteria pass on the fresh pair
selection_criteria.rule: choose the SMALLEST rho in the grid meeting every criterion; report the memory-lifetime tradeoff (old-cue depression retained) for every rho without using it for selection

interpretation: Mechanistic stress test of continual learning; no sports data, no outcomes. Answers whether dopamine-gated recovery preserves usable KC->MBON dynamic range without destroying cue-specific memory.
